description: Send a WhatsApp Flow message. Flows are Meta's structured UI experiences (forms, appointment booking, etc.) rendered inside WhatsApp.

flow_action_payload.description: Optional action payload: { screen, data }. Required for navigate.

flow_cta.description: Label on the button that opens the flow (max 20 chars)

flow_token.description: Opaque token your server correlates with this send

mode.description: Flow mode. Use draft while testing.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 without +

name: send_interactive_flow
